zh.title: TUI Airways 787-8罕見飛抵桃園　疑赴長榮航太進行維修維護
zh.summary: TUI Airways一架波音787-8於10月4日由倫敦蓋威克飛抵桃園；該公司未營運臺灣定期航線，此次航班疑與長榮航太維修維護需求有關。
body: 英國途易航空（TUI Airways）一架波音787-8 Dreamliner於2026年10月4日下午自倫敦蓋威克機場（LGW）飛抵臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。由於TUI Airways目前並未營運任何往返臺灣的定期客運航線，因此該公司787出現在桃園屬相當少見的航機動態，也與一般載客航班有所不同。
此次抵臺航機為TUI Airways旗下波音787-8。TUI Airways主要以英國市場為營運核心，787機隊多投入加勒比海、北美及其他中長程休閒航線；截至2026年10月的桃園機場定期航線資料中，TUI Airways並非營運航空公司之一，因此其787直接由英國飛抵臺灣並非常態性的商業航班。
TUI集團旗下787過去也曾罕見出現在桃園。例如TUI fly Netherlands註冊編號PH-TFL的787-8，就曾於2026年6月24日在桃園機場被記錄。這類TUI 787赴臺航班通常並非載客航線，而是因航機維修、維護或相關技術需求而進行的調機飛行，因此每次抵臺都屬相對少見的航空迷觀察紀錄。
桃園機場周邊設有長榮航太科技（Evergreen Aviation Technologies Corporation，EGAT）的維修基地。長榮航太主要提供機體、發動機及零組件維修服務，並取得臺灣民航局、美國FAA、歐洲EASA及英國UK CAA等多國民航主管機關認證，長期承接國內外航空公司的飛機維修業務。
因此，TUI旗下787並非因臺英定期航線而出現在桃園，而是在有維修或維護需求時才會以調機方式飛抵臺灣。此次787-8由倫敦蓋威克直飛桃園，也被認為是前往長榮航太接受維修、檢查或其他技術作業。不過截至目前，TUI Airways及長榮航太尚未公開此次航機實際執行的維修項目與預計停留時間。
對臺灣航空迷而言，TUI Airways的787因此屬於桃園機場相當少見的到場機型與塗裝。由於該公司沒有飛航臺灣的定期航班，通常只有在航機需要赴臺進行維修維護等特殊任務時，才有機會在桃園看到TUI集團旗下的Dreamliner。

en.title: TUI Airways 787-8 Makes Rare Arrival at Taoyuan, Believed Bound for EGAT Maintenance
en.summary: A TUI Airways Boeing 787-8 arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport from London Gatwick on October 4. With no scheduled TUI service to Taiwan, the flight is believed to be related to maintenance work at Evergreen Aviation Technologies.
body: A TUI Airways Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) from London Gatwick Airport (LGW) on the afternoon of October 4, 2026. TUI Airways does not currently operate scheduled passenger services to or from Taiwan, making the appearance of one of its 787s at Taoyuan a relatively rare aircraft movement and distinct from a regular passenger flight.

The aircraft arriving in Taiwan was a Boeing 787-8 operated by TUI Airways. The airline is primarily focused on the United Kingdom market, with its 787 fleet commonly deployed on leisure routes to the Caribbean, North America and other medium- and long-haul destinations. As of October 2026, TUI Airways is not listed among the airlines operating scheduled services at Taoyuan, so a direct TUI 787 flight from the United Kingdom to Taiwan is not part of normal commercial operations.

TUI Group 787s have also made rare appearances at Taoyuan in the past. For example, TUI fly Netherlands Boeing 787-8 PH-TFL was recorded at the airport on June 24, 2026. Such TUI 787 visits to Taiwan are generally not scheduled passenger services, but positioning flights associated with aircraft maintenance, servicing or other technical requirements, making each arrival a relatively unusual sight for aviation enthusiasts.

Evergreen Aviation Technologies Corporation (EGAT) operates a maintenance base near Taoyuan Airport. EGAT provides airframe, engine and component maintenance services and holds approvals from multiple civil aviation authorities, including Taiwan's CAA, the U.S. FAA, EASA and the UK CAA. The company has long provided maintenance services for both domestic and international airline customers.

TUI 787s therefore do not appear at Taoyuan because of scheduled Taiwan-UK service, but may be positioned to Taiwan when maintenance or servicing is required. The October 4 flight from London Gatwick to Taoyuan is likewise believed to be bound for EGAT for maintenance, inspection or other technical work. However, neither TUI Airways nor EGAT has publicly disclosed the specific work planned for this aircraft or how long it is expected to remain in Taiwan.

For aviation enthusiasts in Taiwan, a TUI Airways 787 is therefore a comparatively rare arrival and livery at Taoyuan. Because the airline does not operate scheduled flights to Taiwan, opportunities to see a TUI Group Dreamliner at the airport generally arise only when an aircraft is sent to Taiwan for maintenance, servicing or another special-purpose mission.
